svg.title: Two models, one verdict, evidence attached
svg.desc: Two controlled profiles with the same daytime development at different hours, rendered side by side, with the windowAgreement finding compareForecasts computed from them: 2 voters, unanimous true.

svg.aria-label: Meteogram for Synthetic Ridge, model model-timing-disagreement, 2000-01-01 12:00 to 17:00 (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.
